### Download
| | |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `Slock-Windows.zip` — extract it, run `Slock/Slock.exe` |
| **Mac** | `Slock-Mac.zip` — extract it, then **right-click `Slock.app` → Open** (it isn't signed by Apple yet) |
| **Linux** | `Slock-Linux.tar.gz` — extract it, run `Slock/Slock.x86_64` |

### What's new
- **New controls, rebuilt from the ground up.** Tilt the board and Slock slides downhill under real physics: the harder you tilt, the harder it's pushed, and tilting back slows it down. It stays centred in the corridors, and at a junction it lines up with the opening you tilt toward and goes in.
- **Lanes on the floor** show the row and column Slock is on, out to the walls: the ways you can go from where you are.
- **A welcome screen** explains how to play, with each rule next to the real model it's about: Slock, the gate and key, pellets, the clock, a swurm, every powerup and a slug. It shows the first time you play; press **H** on the title screen to see it again.
- **The music** starts fading in as soon as your first run begins.

Early pre-release: Windows and Mac builds haven't been tried on real machines yet. If something breaks, please [open an issue](https://github.com/pixelhackstudios/slock/issues).
